judge.rationale: The finding explicitly states the handler writes directly via InventoryRepository().save(), bypassing the single write point InventoryReservationService (criterion 1); it cites docs/decisions/ADR-004.md with the exact rule text ('All inventory writes must go through InventoryReservationService. Direct repository writes from API handlers are prohibited'), not a generic style preference (criterion 2); the proposed fix constructs InventoryReservationService(InventoryRepository()) and calls service.save(), restoring the mandated single write path (criterion 3); and it cites api_handler.py:8, which correctly matches the repository.save(...) write line in the staged diff (criterion 4).
